findings.title: Expiry DC is masked by the earlier manifest guard
findings.description: The packet's full_action_basis_denials_dc oracle requires source/runtime expiry rejection and a fresh trusted post-lock expiry crossing. seed_source gives policy validity, admission validity, runtime validity, projection validity and the resulting manifest the same end timestamp (tests/db/test_full_action_preparation.py:244-255, 370-407, 605-619). consumer_denial varies that common timestamp rather than a single tighter source/runtime bound (2088-2091, 2141-2175). The actual after_expiry witness in full_action_suite_dc.log:687-689 observes a real S29 blocker and crosses time, but reports 'attempt/request/manifest/epoch/stage basis changed or expired': _prepare_current_progress rejects the expired manifest before _verify_full_progress can exercise the source/runtime/full-certificate validity checks. The preparation lease crossing proves lease freshness only. No other parametrized case isolates runtime expiry or admitted-source expiry while manifest and lease remain live. Thus the real-PG expiry oracle is incomplete despite 48 successful tests; this finding is an evidence gap, not a demonstrated defect in the visible minimum calculation.
findings.requested_change: Add owner-driven PostgreSQL trajectories with distinct validity bounds so source admission and registered runtime can each be the limiting dependency while manifest/current-chain ingress remains valid. For full validation and actual COMMIT_READY, show success before and denial after the limiting bound, observe bounded pg_blocking_pids/barrier witnesses for post-lock crossings, assert the intended denial stage and exact zero rows/receipt/event/outbox/stage/pointer effects, and retain immutable prior outputs. Reexecute the named selector and full own suite, update the result and raw evidence on the new tested revision, and obtain fresh reviews.

findings.title: COMMIT_READY lacks independent current-chain denial cases
findings.description: The exact packet requires real owners and actual COMMIT_READY independently to reject current manifest, attempt, fence and lease loss. The consumer matrix (tests/db/test_full_action_preparation.py:1339-1353) includes resolution swap, foreign validation/resolution, runtime revocation, execution basis, epoch, request revision, control, deadline and common expiry. It has no consumer cases for a newly published current manifest, mismatched/current-attempt loss, wrong/taken-over fence, or lease crossing after the consumer waits on S29. The similarly named preparation negatives run ResolveEvidence, not AdvanceAttempt(COMMIT_READY). F2 repair demonstrates request-revision/old-attempt rejection but does not isolate current-attempt, fence or lease under an otherwise valid full certificate/current revision. The shared guards exist in code; their PostgreSQL consumer oracles still have not executed as required by this packet's DoD.
findings.requested_change: Extend the own consumer matrix with valid persisted full certificates and separate current-manifest, current-attempt, fence/takeover and post-lock lease-loss controls. Use fresh command keys, prove valid authenticated ingress followed by the intended current-state guard, and assert complete zero-effect snapshots and non-executable outputs. Commit new raw selector/suite evidence and rerun all required task checks before fresh SHA-bound review.
